reviews.title: White Buttons

reviews.title: No longer good
reviews.text: I used to LOVE this alarm and used it for years. The last couple of years I’ve been a stay at home mom and have rarely needed an alarm. Now my son is in school full time and I’m back to needing an alarm every day. This app does NOT work like it used it, I’m so so so disappointed. First of all, if you listen to white noise and have it playing when the alarm goes off, it blasts the volume to 100% when the alarm is set to go off, which scares the hell out of me and wakes me up before the alarm even starts. Whatever, I figured I could start playing white noise on my TV instead. But now I’ve noticed that the volume doesn’t gradually increase anymore! It used to start nice and quiet and gradually get louder over a couple of minutes, which I loved because I absolutely hate the jarring sound of an alarm, even a pleasant sounding one. Now it’s just a regular loud alarm like every other one out there. It also doesn’t seem to wake you during the light part of your sleep cycle like it used to either, which was surprisingly very helpful even if it went off a few minutes earlier than you wanted it to. I’m so so so disappointed. I loved this alarm and it worked so well before.

reviews.title: Breaks my Eardrums
reviews.text: I've been looking for an app that can wake me up a little less aggressively than my normal alarm, and I thought this might work with the 30 minute wakeup, but no. I often listen to white noise or an audiobook through headphones to fall asleep, but when this first alarm starts, it increases whatever other audio is playing to 100%, blasts my eardrums, and shocks me awake more aggressively than my regular alarm. I've tried turning on "air play" in the app and turning the volume for the alarm itself to 0, nothing works. App doesn't have support available beyond generic faqs so here we are.

reviews.title: Screen too bright since latest upgrade
reviews.text: I’ve used Sleep Time for well over a decade and have genuinely loved it. That’s why this latest update is disappointing. The new interface has too many bright white buttons and screen elements, making it much too bright for nighttime use. For a sleep app, dark, low-light usability should be a priority. Please consider adding a true dark mode or reducing the brightness of the buttons. I’d love to keep using the app I’ve trusted for years.

reviews.title: I have been using this app since April 2014
reviews.text:
When I first started using this app, it was amazing. It actually recorded when I would sleep and listen to the deep/light sleep periods. 

Something happened one day when it updated and it never worked the same. If I remember correctly, it was related to the iOS restrictions to curb apps monitoring you all the time. So I believe they were forced to change the algorithm to checking in periodically rather than constantly. 

This led to a less desirable tracking. While although that was great at the time, what I love is the alarm. 

You set your window, mine is 30 minutes. And if I set my alarm at 7, it could wake me up anywhere between 630 and 730. It tries to listen more during that time and if I stir, it’ll play the gradual melody to wake me up. 

What gets people is the snooze. Shake the thing and it’ll snooze. There’s another parameter you can set to lower the snooze time and the amount of times you can snooze. If you say 10 mins, but say you can snooze 3 times, that’s 30 mins. My alarm would then max wake me up at 8 by my example. 

So on average if I want to wake up around 7, I would set my alarm at around 6:10. 

If you want a “hard wake up” like a normal alarm clock. This app is not for you.

reviews.title: Used to be great...
reviews.text: ...then they “updated” it.  All the screens are bright white. Terrible to look at when you’re about to go to sleep.  Black it out please.  I don’t mind the ads, but the app also maxes out the volume when the alarm goes off. Give me a setting to disable the audible alarm. The buzzer wakes me up, I haven’t heard the alarm in years, but if it snoozed and I’m looking at something on my phone, when the alarm goes off again, (only buzzing, not audible yet) the volume jacks all the way up, regardless of what I’m doing.  Nothing like looking at a YouTube or TikTok and having the audio go from 15% to 100 instantly with no warning.  It’s ridiculous.  There’s one setting for alarm volume in the app, but it does nothing.  Anyway, it used to be an amazing app, now I’m looking for something better.

reviews.title: Good luck.
reviews.text: Maybe this is a great app but you’ll never know bc it’s impossible to figure out how to use it. There is lots of flashy “concept” content if you dig around but nothing that actually tells you how to use the bleeping thing. I downloaded it and it immediately decided I was trying to sleep... at 10 am. Now it’s 11:41 and it’s telling me my alarm is set for 6am. I don’t want to get up at 6 am. I can understand waking me up +/- 30 minutes from a time I set. Or after it’s done some machine learning of my sleep patterns. But it has literally only “known” for a few waking hours so why is it trying to force me awake with only six hours of sleep and one and a half hours before I normally get up!?!?
